script.thesis: What left still occupies the room until you leave the gap named.
script.monologue: Don't postpone naming what left. I don't close the half-packed box. Even if it aches, I leave the hanger empty. Leave the gap named now. So I set the unused key down. You walk the empty path. You stop in the kitchen dark. Still the hanger hangs alone now. You face the empty tide path.
